info.name: Zelda API
info.description:
This collection covers functional testing of the **Zelda API**, focusing on the **Games** endpoint. It is organized into three test categories:

- **Positive Testing** – Validates successful scenarios such as listing all games, retrieving a game by ID or name, verifying required fields, checking default and parameterized item counts, and ensuring correct pagination behavior.
    
- **Negative Testing** – Covers error-handling scenarios including non-existent IDs (with valid and invalid formats) and pagination behavior when no items are available.
    
- **Improvements** – Documents edge cases and potential API issues, such as negative pagination values, incorrect data types in query parameters, and unsupported HTTP methods.
    

The collection uses the `{{baseURL}}` environment variable to manage the base URL and supports the `Zelda-API-Dev` environment for configuration.
